exclusion_detail: Lead 7c needs 5 reactions (Scheme 1 / section 3.1): EDCI/HOBt coupling of Boc-D-proline with 3-aminopyridine, TFA Boc removal, phenyl chloroformate carbamate formation, hydrazinolysis to the semicarbazide, MsCl-mediated coupling with 2-chlorobenzoic acid. All of 7a-7s share this route, so 7p is 5 steps too.

lead.label: 7c
lead.why: Abstract names two potent compounds (7c and 7p) and says '7c exhibited promised anti-breast cancer effect in vivo' (rule 2: the compound of the main follow-up experiment).

notes: Abstract does not single out one best compound (7c and 7p), so rule 2 (in vivo experiment) picks 7c; 7p would also be 5 steps, so the decision is unaffected.
